note: The OLG has extensive content on the operational implementation of mass changes, primarily through the 'SNAP Annual Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA)' page (under Scheduled Mailings/Projects > SNAP COLA) and the 'Social Security Administration (SSA) Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) Overview' page. The SNAP COLA page explains that USDA FNS adjusts benefits, deductions, and income standards annually effective October 1, that BEACON automatically recalculates all active SNAP households, and provides detailed updated figures (SUAs, standard deductions, shelter deductions, income standards, max benefits). The SSA COLA page covers the annual January SSA adjustment and its downstream impact on SNAP benefits. However, the OLG does not address two specific FNS 741 requirements: (1) the rule that individual notices of adverse action cannot be sent for mass changes — the OLG describes the COLA recalculation process but does not discuss the notice framework or the exception from individual adverse action notice requirements; and (2) the QC variance/error determination aspect — that untimely or incorrect implementation of mass changes results in variances included in error determinations. The latter is a QC-facing requirement, but the timeliness obligation it implies (implement mass changes on schedule or face QC errors) is operationally relevant and not mentioned in the OLG.
